name: fakhm-studio
description: Fakhm Studio — cross-platform AI avatar video studio powered by LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fakhm/shared && npm run build --workspace @fakhm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fakhm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fakhm/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @fakhm/mobile
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css}" "packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,json}" "*.{json,md}" && sql-formatter -l postgresql --fix supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql && sql-formatter -l postgresql --fix supabase/migrations/0002_storage_cleanup.sql
